collocations: despeir-, stressed stem of desperer “be dismayed, lose hope, despair,”
from Latin desperare “to despair, to lose all hope,” from PIE root *spes-
be the despair of sb.：令某人担心（或绝望）
into the depths of despair：陷入极度的绝望之中
words.definition: 绝望；令人绝望的人或事 vi. 绝望；对……丧失信心
words.etymology: “To lose hope, be without hope,” mid-14c., despeiren, from Old French “prosperity;” see speed(n.). Related: Despaired; despairing; despairingly.
words.mnemonic: de-（=without：没有）+spair（=to hope：希望）→没有希望→绝望；

collocations: be in desperate need of sth.：急需……
in a desperate attempt to save herself：为了活命
take desperate measures：采取了铤而走险的办法
words.definition: （因绝望而）不顾一切的；极度渴望的；危急的
words.mnemonic:
de-（向下）+ sper-（=spir：呼吸；呼气）+ -ate（形容词后缀）→低
下头呼气→垂头丧气的；绝望的；不顾一切的；危急的

collocations: desperately ill / unhappy / lonely：病得厉害；极为不快；极其孤独
a note of desperation in his voice：他的语气他急得要命

an act of sheer desperation：完全绝望的行为
笔 记 区
a despairing cry / look / sigh：绝望的呼声 / 神情 / 叹息
words.definition: 感到绝望的；没有希望的

words.mnemonic: pro-（向前）+ -sper（=hope：希望）→前面有希望→繁荣；成功

collocations: a prosperous British family：一个富裕的英国家族
words.mnemonic: prosper（繁荣；成功）+ -ous（形容词后缀）→繁荣的；成功的

collocations: a new era of peace and prosperity：和平繁荣的新时代
Japan’s economic prosperity：日本的经济繁荣
a person or community is doing well financially.
words.mnemonic: prosper（繁荣；成功）+ -ity（名词后缀）→繁荣；富足
